questions.explanation: In a relative clause the relative pronoun is the object, so do not repeat it with it.

wrongReasons.0: Do not repeat the object: 'which' already replaces 'it'.
wrongReasons.2: 'what' cannot be used as a relative pronoun after a noun.

options: The book which I bought it was boring.
The book which I bought was boring.
The book what I bought was boring.

questions.explanation: 'Be used to' is followed by the -ing form: I'm used to getting up early.

wrongReasons.1: After 'be used to', use the -ing form.
wrongReasons.2: 'I used to' is followed by the base form and means a past habit.

options: I'm used to getting up early.
I'm used to get up early.
I used to getting up early.
